interpretation: The reference uses enclosing convex hulls of official collision meshes and exact official finger boxes. Positive hull distance proves separation of those original meshes; negative hull distance may be caused by filled concavities. False negatives relative to this reference are candidates, not automatically proven original-mesh collisions. Strict sign uses distance < 0 without collision-threshold relaxation.
online_policy: all robot geometries versus each obstacle, including fixed base; default welded base/table filter retained
